# CLAUDE.md

Jekyll personal site (al-folio theme) for Spencer Barton, deployed at https://sbarton272.github.io.

## Blog tag filters (`display_tags`)

The blog front page ([blog/index.html](blog/index.html)) shows a row of tag filter links,
driven by `display_tags` in [_config.yml](_config.yml) (search for `display_tags:`).

**Important:** `display_tags` only controls which tags are *linked* on the front page. It does
**not** create the tag pages. The `/blog/tag/<name>/` pages are generated by the
`jekyll-archives` plugin, and a page is created **only for tags that appear on at least one
post**. A tag listed in `display_tags` with zero matching posts produces a dead link (404).

**Rule — keep `display_tags` showing the top *available* tags:**

- Every tag in `display_tags` MUST be present on at least one published post in `_posts/`
  (otherwise the front-page link 404s).
- Prefer the most-used tags, roughly ordered by number of posts (the "top available tags").
- To see which tags actually exist and their counts:

  ```sh
  grep -rh "^tags:" _posts/ | sed 's/^tags: *//' | tr ' ' '\n' | sort | grep . | uniq -c | sort -rn
  ```

- After adding/removing posts or retagging, re-check `display_tags` against that list and update
  it so it reflects the real, most-common tags.

Note: `_drafts/` posts are not published and do not generate tag pages — only `_posts/` count.
